title: Italian Watermelon and Paneer Salad
description: A refreshing Italian-inspired salad featuring paneer, watermelon, and a hint of nutty sweetness.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine paneer, watermelon, and nutty (if using).
2. In a small bowl, whisk together sweet and a pinch of salt.
3. Pour the sweet mixture over the paneer mixture and toss to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
5. Just before serving, top the salad with diced avocado (if using).
